notes: A very common particle used for surprise, response, softening, or emphasis. It often appears at the end of a sentence.
ex1_sentence: 你今天也来啊，我们一起吃饭。
ex1_translation: You're coming today too, right? Let's eat together.
ex2_sentence: 啊，你的手机在桌子下面。
ex2_translation: Oh, your phone is under the table.
ex3_sentence: 原来爸爸已经回家了啊。
ex3_translation: Oh, so Dad is already home.

notes: Usually means romantic love or a love relationship, not general liking.
ex1_sentence: 男朋友给她买花，这就是爱情。
ex1_translation: Her boyfriend buys her flowers. That's love.
ex2_sentence: 她很喜欢电影里的爱情。
ex2_translation: She really likes the romance in the movie.
ex3_sentence: 爸爸说，爱情和电影不一样。
ex3_translation: Dad says love isn't the same as it is in the movies.

notes: In modern Mainland Chinese this most often means one's husband or wife. In some contexts it can also mean lover.
ex1_sentence: 今天她和爱人一起去超市。
ex1_translation: Today she and her partner are going to the supermarket together.
ex2_sentence: 她的爱人在车站等她回家。
ex2_translation: Her partner is waiting at the station for her to come home.
ex3_sentence: 晚上他和爱人在饭馆吃饭。
ex3_translation: In the evening, he eats at a restaurant with his partner.

notes: Usually describes a quiet person, place, or atmosphere. It can also be used as a gentle request meaning 'be quiet'.
ex1_sentence: 图书馆很安静，大家都读书。
ex1_translation: The library is quiet, and everyone is reading.
ex2_sentence: 这个小房间很安静，妈妈在里边休息。
ex2_translation: This small room is very peaceful, and Mom is resting inside.
ex3_sentence: 上课的时候大家要安静。
ex3_translation: Everyone needs to be quiet during class.

notes: Usually means safe or secure. It can describe a person, place, situation, or object.
ex1_sentence: 晚上一个人回家不太安全。
ex1_translation: It's not very safe to go home alone at night.
ex2_sentence: 这个地铁站很安全，大家都放心。
ex2_translation: This subway station is very safe, so everyone feels at ease.
ex3_sentence: 钱包放在妈妈包里很安全。
ex3_translation: The wallet is safe in Mom's bag.

notes: The basic color word for white. It is often used in phrases like 白色的... to describe color.
ex1_sentence: 桌子上边有一个白色杯子。
ex1_translation: There is a white cup on the table.
ex2_sentence: 她今天穿白色大衣去上班。
ex2_translation: She's wearing a white coat to work today.
ex3_sentence: 这个白色书包很好看，我想买。
ex3_translation: This white schoolbag looks nice, and I want to buy it.

notes: Usually means the student who leads or helps manage a class.
ex1_sentence: 今天班长帮助老师发课本。
ex1_translation: Today the class monitor helps the teacher hand out textbooks.
ex2_sentence: 老师今天不在，班长帮助大家。
ex2_translation: The teacher isn't here today, so the class monitor helps everyone.
ex3_sentence: 班长在教学楼门口等老师。
ex3_translation: The class monitor is waiting for the teacher at the entrance to the classroom building.

notes: A very common verb meaning to do, handle, or take care of something such as work, paperwork, or a problem.
ex1_translation: The car broke down. What should we do now?
ex2_sentence: 家里的事他一个人办不了。
ex2_translation: He can't take care of the things at home by himself.
ex3_sentence: 爸爸上午出去办这个事。
ex3_translation: Dad went out this morning to handle this matter.

notes: Usually means a way, method, or solution for dealing with a problem or situation.
ex1_sentence: 门打不开，爸爸想了一个办法。
ex1_translation: The door wouldn't open, so Dad thought of a way.
ex2_sentence: 电脑坏了，哥哥还有办法。
ex2_translation: The computer is broken, but my older brother still has a solution.
ex3_sentence: 今天下雨，我们没有办法打球。
ex3_translation: It's raining today, so we have no way to play ball.

notes: A common word for an office room or workplace.
ex1_sentence: 爸爸现在在办公室里工作。
ex1_translation: Dad is working in the office now.
ex2_sentence: 下午我去办公室找老师。
ex2_translation: I am going to the office this afternoon to find the teacher.
ex3_sentence: 这个办公室不大，但是很安静。
ex3_translation: This office is not big, but it is very quiet.

notes: Usually refers to very late at night or the middle of the night.
ex1_sentence: 半夜他还没有回到家里。
ex1_translation: He still had not gotten home in the middle of the night.
ex2_sentence: 妈妈半夜起来看弟弟睡觉。
ex2_translation: Mom got up in the middle of the night to check on my younger brother sleeping.
ex3_sentence: 半夜的时候外边很安静。
ex3_translation: Outside is very quiet at midnight.

notes: A common word for helping someone or giving help.
ex1_sentence: 老师常常帮助那个新同学。
ex1_translation: The teacher often helps that new student.
ex2_sentence: 这本词典帮助我学汉语。
ex2_translation: This dictionary helps me learn Chinese.
ex3_sentence: 谢谢你帮助妈妈找手机。
ex3_translation: Thank you for helping Mom find her phone.

notes: Usually means full after eating.
ex1_translation: I ate two buns, and I am full.
ex2_translation: Dad ate too much dinner and got too full.
ex3_translation: My younger brother said he is full.

notes: Usually means to sign up or register for a class, test, or activity.
ex1_sentence: 姐姐昨天去学校报名了。
ex1_translation: My older sister went to school yesterday to sign up.
ex2_sentence: 我想报名参加这个活动。
ex2_translation: I want to register for this activity.
ex3_translation: Please bring your phone when you sign up.

notes: The common word for a newspaper.
ex1_translation: Grandpa reads the newspaper at home in the morning.
ex2_translation: Today's newspaper is on the table.
ex3_sentence: 爸爸下班后买了一份报纸。
ex3_translation: Dad bought a newspaper after work.

notes: Usually means the north or northern part of a place.
ex1_translation: My grandpa lives in the north now.
ex2_sentence: 冬天的时候北方很冷吗？
ex2_translation: Is the northern part very cold in winter?
ex3_sentence: 北方的春天来得晚一点儿。
ex3_translation: Spring comes a little later in the north.

notes: Usually means to carry something on your back.
ex1_translation: My younger brother goes to school carrying his schoolbag on his back.
ex2_translation: Mom carried the child home on her back.
ex3_translation: He walks slowly with a big bag on his back.

notes: Used to introduce examples.
ex1_sentence: 我想买学习的东西，比如笔和本子。
ex1_translation: I want to buy study supplies, such as pens and notebooks.
ex2_sentence: 早饭我常吃这些，比如面包和鸡蛋。
ex2_translation: I often eat these things for breakfast, for example bread and eggs.
ex3_sentence: 图书馆里有很多书，比如汉语词典。
ex3_translation: There are many books in the library, such as Chinese dictionaries.

notes: A common phrase used to introduce an example.
ex1_sentence: 我爱好很多，比如说看书和唱歌。
ex1_translation: I have many hobbies, for example reading and singing.
ex2_sentence: 这家饭馆有很多菜，比如说包子和面条儿。
ex2_translation: This restaurant has many dishes, such as buns and noodles.
ex3_sentence: 学校旁边有很多地方，比如说商店和公园。
ex3_translation: There are many places near the school, for example shops and parks.

notes: The common word for a pen.
ex1_translation: My pen is in my schoolbag.
ex2_translation: My older sister just bought a new pen.
ex3_translation: The teacher said my pen is pretty good.

notes: Usually means notes you write down while studying or listening.
ex1_sentence: 上课的时候我常写笔记。
ex1_translation: I often take notes during class.
ex2_sentence: 妈妈看了我的汉语笔记。
ex2_translation: Mom looked at my Chinese notes.
ex3_translation: I want to take this notebook of notes home.

notes: Usually means a paper notebook for writing notes.
ex1_translation: My notebook is on the table.
ex2_sentence: 姐姐买了一个新笔记本。
ex2_translation: My older sister bought a new notebook.
ex3_sentence: 上课的时候我要带笔记本。
ex3_translation: I need to bring a notebook during class.

notes: A common word for something necessary or required.
ex1_sentence: 明天有考试，我必须复习。
ex1_translation: I have an exam tomorrow, so I must review.
ex2_sentence: 过马路的时候必须看车。
ex2_translation: You must watch for cars when crossing the road.
ex3_sentence: 弟弟生病了，必须去医院。
ex3_translation: My younger brother is sick, so he has to go to the hospital.

notes: Usually means a side or area in standard phrases like 这边 or 那边.
ex1_translation: There is a supermarket on this side of the station.
ex2_translation: Sit on my side.
ex3_translation: That side of the school is very quiet at night.

notes: A common verb for changing or becoming different.
ex1_translation: The weather suddenly turned cold today.
ex2_sentence: 弟弟看到老师就变安静了。
ex2_translation: My younger brother became quiet as soon as he saw the teacher.
ex3_sentence: 他的脸一下儿就变红了。
ex3_translation: His face suddenly turned red.

notes: Usually means to become something or change into a new state.
ex1_sentence: 这个地方后来变成公园了。
ex1_translation: This place later became a park.
ex2_sentence: 这个小孩子后来变成大人了。
ex2_translation: This little child later became an adult.
ex3_sentence: 白色的花后来变成红色了。
ex3_translation: The white flowers later turned red.

notes: A measure word for the number of times an action is done from beginning to end.
ex1_translation: I read this book twice.
ex2_translation: Please say the teacher's words one more time.
ex3_translation: I wrote this character three times.

notes: Usually means a watch worn on the wrist.
ex1_translation: Dad's watch is on the table.
ex2_translation: I want to buy a new watch.
ex3_translation: His watch is running too fast.

notes: Common verb for saying or showing something clearly.
ex1_sentence: 老师今天表示我们可以回家。
ex1_translation: The teacher expressed that we could go home today.
ex2_sentence: 他今天表示可以去学校。
ex2_translation: He said that he could go to school today.
ex3_sentence: 这个句子表示我们要回家。
ex3_translation: This sentence indicates that we need to go home.

notes: A common way to say something is quite good or not bad.
ex1_translation: This restaurant is really not bad.
ex2_translation: Your Chinese is pretty good now.
ex3_sentence: 今天天气不错，我们出去吧。
ex3_translation: The weather is nice today, so let's go out.

notes: Usually appears in a paired structure to add another point.
ex1_sentence: 他不但会说汉语，而且会写汉字。
ex1_translation: He can not only speak Chinese, but also write Chinese characters.
ex2_sentence: 这个公园不但大，而且很安静。
ex2_translation: This park is not only big, but also very quiet.
ex3_sentence: 妈妈做的菜不但好看，而且好吃。
ex3_translation: The dishes Mom makes are not only nice-looking, but also tasty.

notes: Used when something is insufficient.
ex1_sentence: 一杯水不够，你再喝一点儿。
ex1_translation: One cup of water is not enough; drink a little more.
ex2_sentence: 时间不够，我们先回家吧。
ex2_translation: There is not enough time, so let's go home first.
ex3_sentence: 这个包太小，不够放电脑。
ex3_translation: This bag is too small and not big enough to hold a computer.

notes: A common word for adding a contrast, like however or but.
ex1_sentence: 我很想去，不过今天很忙。
ex1_translation: I really want to go; however, I'm very busy today.
ex2_sentence: 这家店很小，不过东西不错。
ex2_translation: This shop is small, but the things there are pretty good.
ex3_translation: He can drive, but he does not drive often.

notes: Used before adjectives or verbs to soften a negative statement.
ex1_translation: I do not really want to go out today.
ex2_translation: This place is not very quiet.
ex3_translation: He is not too happy today.

notes: A direct way to tell someone not to do something.
ex1_translation: It is raining, so do not go out.
ex2_translation: This book is expensive, so do not buy it.
ex3_translation: The teacher said not to talk during class.

notes: It can mean sorry in polite situations, and it can also describe feeling embarrassed.
ex1_sentence: 不好意思，我今天来晚了。
ex1_translation: Sorry, I came late today.
ex2_sentence: 我拿错你的书了，不好意思。
ex2_translation: I took your book by mistake. Sorry.
ex3_sentence: 大家都看他，他很不好意思。
ex3_translation: Everyone was looking at him, and he felt embarrassed.

notes: Usually means soon or before long after a point in time.
ex1_sentence: 爸爸出门不久就回来了。
ex1_translation: Dad came back soon after going out.
ex2_translation: Spring will be here before long.
ex3_sentence: 他们认识不久，就成了朋友。
ex3_translation: Soon after they met, they became friends.

notes: Usually means dissatisfied or unhappy with something.
ex1_sentence: 顾客对这个服务很不满。
ex1_translation: The customer is very dissatisfied with this service.
ex2_sentence: 爸爸对我的成绩很不满。
ex2_translation: Dad is very dissatisfied with my grades.
ex3_sentence: 这个服务让大家很不满。
ex3_translation: This service makes everyone unhappy.

notes: Often used in comparisons, and it can also suggest a better choice.
ex1_sentence: 这个办法不如那个办法好。
ex1_translation: This way is not as good as that way.
ex2_sentence: 坐公共汽车去，不如坐地铁快。
ex2_translation: Going by bus is not as fast as taking the subway.
ex3_sentence: 今天出去玩儿，不如在家看电影。
ex3_translation: Rather than go out today, it is better to watch a movie at home.

notes: Means more than a few, often quite a lot.
ex1_translation: There are quite a few people in the supermarket today.
ex2_translation: My older sister bought a lot of notebooks.
ex3_sentence: 这本词典帮助了不少学生。
ex3_translation: This dictionary has helped quite a few students.

notes: A common adjective for things that are not the same.
ex1_translation: These two places are very different.
ex2_sentence: 爸爸和妈妈的工作不同。
ex2_translation: Dad's and Mom's jobs are different.
ex3_translation: Spring and winter are very different.

notes: Used when something is not acceptable, not possible, or will not work.
ex1_sentence: 现在出发不行，外边下雨。
ex1_translation: It is not okay to leave now, because it is raining outside.
ex2_sentence: 这个办法不行，我们再想。
ex2_translation: This method won't do, so let's think again.
ex3_sentence: 今天我太累了，真的不行。
ex3_translation: I am too tired today; I really can't do it.

notes: Used when something may be true, but is not certain.
ex1_sentence: 明天不一定下雨，我们先别走。
ex1_translation: It may not rain tomorrow, so let's not leave yet.
ex2_translation: He is not necessarily at home now.
ex3_translation: This method is not necessarily the best.

notes: Means after a short time.
ex1_sentence: 我等了不一会儿，他就来了。
ex1_translation: I waited a little while, and then he came.
ex2_sentence: 不一会儿，大家都到办公室了。
ex2_translation: Soon, everyone arrived at the office.
ex3_sentence: 她出去不一会儿就回来了。
ex3_translation: She came back soon after going out.

notes: Used for a part or portion of something larger.
ex1_sentence: 我看了这本书的一部分。
ex1_translation: I read part of this book.
ex2_sentence: 这次活动有一部分学生参加。
ex2_translation: Part of the students are joining this activity.
ex3_sentence: 地图的一部分我看不懂。
ex3_translation: There is part of the map that I cannot understand.

notes: This often means only, or not until a certain time or condition.
ex1_translation: I only found out about this today.
ex2_sentence: 今天半夜他才回到家里。
ex2_translation: He did not get home until the middle of the night today.
ex3_translation: I waited until evening, and only then did he come.

notes: The list of dishes or drinks at a restaurant.
ex1_sentence: 饭馆门口有今天的菜单。
ex1_translation: Today's menu is at the restaurant entrance.
ex2_sentence: 我看了菜单，想吃面条儿。
ex2_translation: I looked at the menu and want to eat noodles.
ex3_translation: There are many dishes on this menu.

notes: Usually means to visit a place and look around.
ex1_sentence: 明天我们去参观动物园。
ex1_translation: We are going to visit the zoo tomorrow.
ex2_translation: The teacher is taking everyone on a tour of the school.
ex3_translation: I want to take Mom to visit the company.

notes: A common verb for joining an activity, class, or event.
ex1_sentence: 哥哥明天参加那个活动。
ex1_translation: My older brother is taking part in that activity tomorrow.
ex2_translation: I want to join the school activity.
ex3_sentence: 很多人参加了这次参观。
ex3_translation: Many people participated in this visit.

notes: The common word for grass.
ex1_translation: The grass in the park is growing well.
ex2_sentence: 孩子在草地上玩儿，草很多。
ex2_translation: The child is playing on the grass, and there is a lot of grass there.
ex3_sentence: 春天到了，草又长出来了。
ex3_translation: Spring has arrived, and the grass has grown out again.

notes: Usually means a grassy area or lawn.
ex1_translation: The children are playing ball on the grass.
ex2_translation: The lawn is very quiet after the rain.
ex3_sentence: 公园的草地上有很多花。
ex3_translation: There are many flowers on the grass in the park.

notes: Often used as a measure word for floors in a building.
ex1_translation: My home is on the sixth floor.
ex2_translation: This house has three floors.
ex3_translation: The office is on the east side of the second floor.

notes: A common verb for checking, searching, or looking something up.
ex1_translation: Mom is looking up the map on her phone.
ex2_translation: The teacher told me to check this word.
ex3_translation: Dad checked the tickets after he got home.

notes: Usually means almost, or roughly the same.
ex1_translation: It is almost eight o'clock now.
ex2_translation: These two bags are about the same size.
ex3_translation: We are almost there, so don't worry.

notes: This entry is the adjective meaning long.
ex1_translation: This road is very long.
ex2_translation: This coat is too long.
ex3_translation: Winter nights are long.

notes: Used for things that are often seen and very common.
ex1_translation: This character is very common.
ex2_sentence: 这本词典里有很多常见词语。
ex2_translation: This dictionary has many common words and expressions.
ex3_sentence: 在公园里看见狗很常见。
ex3_translation: Seeing dogs in the park is very common.

notes: Used for something that people use often.
ex1_translation: This word is commonly used.
ex2_translation: This is a method we often use.
ex3_sentence: 笔记本和笔都是常用东西。
ex3_translation: Notebooks and pens are both commonly used things.

notes: Often used as a measure word for events, games, films, or scenes.
ex1_translation: There is an activity at school today.
ex2_sentence: 我们晚上看了一场电影。
ex2_translation: We watched a movie tonight.
ex3_translation: This rainstorm is very heavy.

notes: Means to be more than a number, limit, or amount.
ex1_translation: This bag costs more than ten yuan.
ex2_sentence: 今天参加活动的人超过一百了。
ex2_translation: More than one hundred people joined the activity today.
ex3_translation: The time should not go over half an hour.

notes: The common word for a supermarket.
ex1_translation: Mom is going to the supermarket this afternoon to buy vegetables.
ex2_sentence: 这个超市晚上十点关门。
ex2_translation: This supermarket closes at ten at night.
ex3_translation: There are many customers inside the supermarket.

notes: A general word for vehicles, often used in traffic situations.
ex1_translation: There are many vehicles on the road.
ex2_sentence: 晚上这条路上车辆不多。
ex2_translation: There is not much traffic on this road at night.
ex3_sentence: 过马路的时候要看车辆。
ex3_translation: You need to watch for vehicles when crossing the road.

notes: Common verb for calling someone by a name or title.
ex1_translation: Everyone calls him the class monitor.
ex2_translation: The teacher also calls him the class monitor.
ex3_translation: The students all call him the class monitor.

notes: This common verb can mean succeed, work out, or become in context.
ex1_translation: This matter worked out today.
ex2_sentence: 这个办法不成，我们再想。
ex2_translation: This method will not work, so let's think again.
ex3_translation: He wants to become a painter when he grows up.

notes: Usually means grades or test results at school.
ex1_sentence: 姐姐这次考试成绩很好。
ex1_translation: My older sister got very good grades on this exam.
ex2_translation: Dad cares a lot about my grades.
ex3_translation: The teacher said we will check the results tomorrow.

notes: A common formal verb meaning to become.
ex1_translation: She wants to become a painter.
ex2_sentence: 这个地方后来成为广场。
ex2_translation: This place later became a square.
ex3_translation: Everyone wants to become the class monitor.

notes: A common verb for saying or doing something again.
ex1_translation: Please do not repeat these words.
ex2_translation: The teacher told us to repeat it once.
ex3_sentence: 这个问题他重复问了两遍。
ex3_translation: He asked this question twice over again.

notes: Means again or from the beginning once more.
ex1_sentence: 这本书我想重新看一遍。
ex1_translation: I want to read this book again.
ex2_sentence: 电脑关机以后再重新打开。
ex2_translation: After shutting down the computer, turn it on again.
ex3_sentence: 老师叫我重新写这个字。
ex3_translation: The teacher told me to write this character again.

notes: A common verb for setting out or leaving for a destination.
ex1_sentence: 我们明天早上八点出发。
ex1_translation: We are setting out at eight tomorrow morning.
ex2_translation: Dad has just left the office.
ex3_sentence: 大家准备好了就出发吧。
ex3_translation: Let's set out once everyone is ready.

notes: Means to leave one's country and go to another country.
ex1_translation: My older sister wants to go abroad to study next year.
ex2_translation: His dad often goes abroad for work.
ex3_translation: You need to bring your passport when going abroad.

notes: Usually means an exit in a station, building, or other public place.
ex1_translation: The subway station exit is on the east side.
ex2_translation: This exit is not open today.
ex3_sentence: 我们在出口那边见面吧。
ex3_translation: Let's meet over by the exit.

notes: Usually means to go out or leave the house.
ex1_translation: Mom took her phone before going out.
ex2_sentence: 下雨了，我们今天不出门。
ex2_translation: It is raining, so we are not going out today.
ex3_translation: Dad came back right after going out.

notes: Usually means to be born.
ex1_translation: My younger brother was born last year.
ex2_translation: She was born in Beijing.
ex3_translation: This child was born in the middle of the night.

notes: A common verb for appearing or showing up.
ex1_sentence: 老师刚出现，大家就安静了。
ex1_translation: As soon as the teacher appeared, everyone became quiet.
ex2_translation: A character appeared on the phone screen.
ex3_sentence: 他出现以后，大家都笑了。
ex3_translation: After he showed up, everyone laughed.

notes: Means to leave the hospital after treatment.
ex1_translation: Grandpa left the hospital this afternoon.
ex2_sentence: 爷爷出院以后就回家了。
ex2_translation: Grandpa went home after being discharged from the hospital.
ex3_translation: The doctor said it will be possible to leave the hospital tomorrow.

notes: Usually means to rent something out.
ex1_translation: This house is for rent now.
ex2_translation: There is a house for rent on the east side of the school.
ex3_sentence: 这个办公室不出租给别人。
ex3_translation: This office is not rented out to other people.

notes: The common word for a taxi.
ex1_sentence: 我们下雨天常常坐出租车。
ex1_translation: We often take a taxi on rainy days.
ex2_sentence: 爸爸回家的时候坐出租车。
ex2_translation: Dad takes a taxi when he goes home.
ex3_sentence: 车站外边有很多出租车。
ex3_translation: There are many taxis outside the station.

notes: A common word for a boat or ship.
ex1_translation: We are going to the seaside by boat.
ex2_translation: There is a small boat on the lake.
ex3_translation: Dad does not like traveling by boat.

ex2_translation: I review the text at home in the evening.
ex3_sentence: 老师叫我们回家复习笔记。
ex3_translation: The teacher told us to go home and review our notes.

notes: A common word meaning should or ought to.
ex1_translation: You should go home now.
ex2_translation: We should set out now.
ex3_translation: If you are sick, you should go to the hospital.

notes: A common verb for changing or correcting something.
ex1_translation: This character was written wrong, so it needs to be corrected.
ex2_translation: Can you change the time?
ex3_translation: The teacher told me to correct this character.

notes: A common word for changing something or becoming different.
ex1_translation: Spring changed this park.
ex2_translation: Time changed many things.
ex3_sentence: 两年以后这里改变很大。
ex3_translation: Two years later, this place changed a lot.

notes: A common expression used when people raise drinks together.
ex1_sentence: 大家吃饭的时候一起干杯。
ex1_translation: Everyone says cheers together during the meal.
ex2_translation: Dad happily said, “Come on, cheers.”
ex3_sentence: 春节晚上大家常常干杯。
ex3_translation: People often say cheers on Spring Festival nights.

notes: A common verb for feeling something emotionally or physically.
ex1_translation: I feel a little tired.
ex2_sentence: 爸爸感到这个办法不错。
ex2_translation: Dad feels this method is pretty good.
ex3_sentence: 她看到大海以后感到很高兴。
ex3_translation: After seeing the sea, she felt very happy.

notes: Used when someone is emotionally moved or touched.
ex1_translation: Mom's words really touched me.
ex2_translation: This story moved everyone.
ex3_sentence: 我看完电影以后很感动。
ex3_translation: I felt very moved after watching the movie.

notes: Can be a verb meaning to feel or a noun meaning a feeling or impression.
ex1_translation: I feel it is not very cold today.
ex2_translation: Mom feels a little tired.
ex3_sentence: 我对这个地方感觉很好。
ex3_translation: I have a good feeling about this place.

notes: A common word for thanking someone or feeling grateful.
ex1_translation: I am very grateful for the teacher's help.
ex2_translation: Mom thanks everyone for coming to see her.
ex3_translation: Thank you for taking me home today.

notes: Usually means to do physical work or work on a job.
ex1_translation: Dad is working at home today.
ex2_sentence: 他们上午就出去干活儿。
ex2_translation: They went out to work in the morning.
ex3_sentence: 干活儿以后大家都很累。
ex3_translation: Everyone is tired after working.

notes: Usually means just a moment ago or only just.
ex1_translation: I just got home.
ex2_translation: Dad just went out.
ex3_translation: We just arrived at the subway station.

notes: Means just now, referring to a very recent time.
ex1_translation: Who called you just now?
ex2_sentence: 我刚才在办公室看见老师。
ex2_translation: I saw the teacher in the office just now.
ex3_translation: It rained outside just now.

notes: A common time adverb meaning just or just now.
ex1_translation: I just got back home.
ex2_translation: My older sister just sent a text message.
ex3_translation: We have just arrived at the subway station.

notes: Usually means advanced or higher level.
ex1_translation: This Chinese class is very advanced.
ex2_translation: She is studying advanced Chinese now.
ex3_translation: There are many students in the advanced class.

notes: The common word for senior high school.
ex1_translation: My older sister is in senior high school this year.
ex2_translation: There is a senior high school east of my home.
ex3_translation: The senior high school is in front of the university.

notes: Usually used when talking about a person's height.
ex1_translation: My older brother is very tall.
ex2_translation: This child is not very tall.
ex3_translation: He is taller than Dad.

notes: Used to show a higher degree than before.
ex1_sentence: 春天来了，公园更好看了。
ex1_translation: Spring has come, and the park looks even prettier.
ex2_sentence: 这本词典比那本更有用。
ex2_translation: This dictionary is more useful than that one.
ex3_translation: I want to learn better.

notes: Common word for a bus in everyday city travel.
ex1_sentence: 我今天坐公共汽车去学校。
ex1_translation: I take the bus to school today.
ex2_sentence: 他今天坐公共汽车回家。
ex2_translation: He takes the bus home today.
ex3_sentence: 我们今天坐公共汽车去车站。
ex3_translation: We are taking the bus to the station today.

notes: A common spoken word for a bus.
ex1_translation: There are many buses here.
ex2_translation: We are going to the park by bus.
ex3_sentence: 公交车到了，我们上车吧。
ex3_translation: The bus has arrived, so let's get on.

notes: A common unit for weight.
ex1_translation: This bag weighs five kilograms.
ex2_sentence: 这个孩子已经三十公斤了。
ex2_translation: This child already weighs thirty kilograms.
ex3_translation: This coat weighs less than one kilogram.

notes: A common unit for distance.
ex1_sentence: 从我家到学校有三公里。
ex1_translation: It is three kilometers from my home to school.
ex2_sentence: 从这里到公园有一公里。
ex2_translation: It is one kilometer from here to the park.
ex3_translation: We walked five kilometers today.

notes: A common word for a road or highway.
ex1_translation: This highway is very long.
ex2_translation: There are not many cars on the highway at night.
ex3_translation: There is a restaurant on the east side of the road.

notes: A common adjective meaning fair or just.
ex1_translation: The teacher is fair to everyone.
ex2_translation: This result is fair.
ex3_translation: Everyone thinks this is fair.

notes: The common word for a company.
ex1_translation: Dad works at a company.
ex2_translation: I am going to the company to find Mom.
ex3_translation: This company is very big.

notes: The common word for a park.
ex1_translation: We are going to the park this afternoon to play ball.
ex2_translation: This park is very quiet.
ex3_translation: There is a restaurant across from the park.

notes: The common word for a dog.
ex1_translation: There is a dog at his home.
ex2_translation: The dog is running in the park.
ex3_translation: Children all like little dogs.

notes: Means enough or sufficient.
ex1_translation: Is this water enough?
ex2_translation: Is one hundred yuan enough or not?
ex3_translation: This room is big enough.

notes: The common word for a story.
ex1_translation: This story is very moving.
ex2_sentence: 妈妈晚上读故事给孩子听。
ex2_translation: Mom reads stories to the child at night.
ex3_sentence: 我很喜欢这本书里的故事。
ex3_translation: I really like the stories in this book.

notes: Common adverb for doing something on purpose.
ex1_sentence: 弟弟今天故意打开门了。
ex1_translation: My younger brother deliberately opened the door today.
ex2_translation: He walked very slowly on purpose today.
ex3_sentence: 孩子今天故意让大家笑。
ex3_translation: The child deliberately made everyone laugh today.

notes: A person who buys goods or uses a service.
ex1_translation: There are many customers in the shop.
ex2_translation: This customer wants to buy a coat.
ex3_sentence: 这位顾客常来这家饭馆。
ex3_translation: This customer often comes to this restaurant.

notes: Used for turning off a phone, computer, or other device.
ex1_translation: Please turn it off before class.
ex2_sentence: 开会的时候，大家都关机了。
ex2_translation: During the meeting, everyone turned off their devices.
ex3_sentence: 我的计算机关机了，现在不能上网。
ex3_translation: My computer is shut down, so I cannot go online now.

notes: Usually used for caring about a person, health, study, or situation.
ex1_sentence: 老师很关心我们的学习。
ex1_translation: The teacher cares a lot about our studies.
ex2_translation: Mom often cares about my health.
ex3_sentence: 朋友这样关心我，我很高兴。
ex3_translation: I am happy that my friend cares about me like this.

notes: A person's opinion or way of seeing an issue.
ex1_translation: I want to hear your opinion.
ex2_translation: His opinion is different from mine.
ex3_sentence: 这个问题上，我们的观点一样。
ex3_translation: On this question, our views are the same.

notes: An open public square in a city or town.
ex1_translation: There are many people in the square at night.
ex2_sentence: 我们在广场旁边见面吧。
ex2_translation: Let us meet next to the square.
ex3_translation: The children are running in the square.

notes: A public notice or commercial message.
ex1_translation: This advertisement is too long.
ex2_translation: There are many ads on television.
ex3_sentence: 我不想再看这个广告了。
ex3_translation: I do not want to watch this ad again.

notes: Used for things that involve more than one country.
ex1_sentence: 他在一家国际公司工作。
ex1_translation: He works at an international company.
ex2_translation: This is an international issue.
ex3_sentence: 国际学校里有很多外国学生。
ex3_translation: There are many foreign students at the international school.

notes: Movement toward the speaker or current location.
ex1_translation: Come over and look at this.
ex2_translation: The teacher asked me to come over for a moment.
ex3_sentence: 下班以后，你过来吃饭吧。
ex3_translation: Come over for dinner after work.

primary_gloss: celebrate the New Year; spend the New Year
notes: Usually refers to spending or celebrating the Lunar New Year.
ex1_translation: We are spending the New Year in Beijing this year.
ex2_sentence: 过年的时候，我们都回家。
ex2_translation: When it is New Year, we all go home.
ex3_sentence: 很多人喜欢和家人一起过年。
ex3_translation: Many people like spending the New Year with their family.

notes: Can describe moving to the other side or refer to past time.
ex1_translation: Go over first. I will come right away.
ex2_sentence: 学校在马路对面，我们走过去吧。
ex2_translation: The school is across the road. Let us walk over.
ex3_sentence: 过去的事，我不想再说了。
ex3_translation: I do not want to talk about the past anymore.

notes: A common verb for crossing, passing, or spending a period of time.
ex1_translation: Be careful when crossing the road.
ex2_translation: I want to spend this weekend at home.
ex3_sentence: 上次考试他没过，这次过了。
ex3_translation: He did not pass the exam last time, but he passed this time.

notes: A large body of salt water.
ex1_translation: We want to go see the sea in summer.
ex2_translation: My home is not far from the sea.
ex3_translation: The wind on the sea is strong.

notes: The area next to the sea.
ex1_sentence: 我们放假以后想去海边。
ex1_translation: We want to go to the seaside after vacation starts.
ex2_translation: This hotel is right by the sea.
ex3_translation: The wind by the sea is a little strong.

notes: To call loudly to someone or shout something out.
ex1_translation: He called out my name at the door.
ex2_translation: It is too far away, so shout loudly.
ex3_translation: As soon as Mom called out, I came out.

primary_gloss: good; fine; easy to; okay to
notes: A very flexible common word. It can describe quality, how someone feels, or how easy and suitable something is to do.
ex1_translation: The weather is nice today.
ex2_translation: This book is very enjoyable to read.
ex3_translation: He does very well in his studies.

notes: Common noun meaning benefit or advantage. It is often used in patterns like 对...有好处 to talk about something being good for a person or situation.
ex1_translation: Exercise is good for the body.
ex2_translation: Going to bed early is good for the body.
ex3_translation: This method has many advantages.

notes: Common phrase meaning many or a lot of. It often adds a spoken feeling of surprise or emphasis, like so many.
ex1_translation: So many people came today.
ex2_translation: There are a lot of books on the table.
ex3_translation: There is a lot of fruit in the store.

notes: Common time expression meaning for a long time or after quite a while.
ex1_translation: I waited for a long time.
ex2_translation: He has not come for a long time.
ex3_translation: We have not seen each other for a long time.

notes: A person with a good heart or good behavior.
ex1_sentence: 他常帮助别人，是个好人。
ex1_translation: He often helps other people, so he is a good person.
ex2_translation: Everyone says she is a good person.
ex3_translation: I want to make friends with good people.

notes: Can mean something good that happens or a good deed.
ex1_translation: This really is a good thing.
ex2_translation: Helping other people is a good deed.
ex3_translation: Everyone says this is a good thing.

notes: Common verb for seeming or appearing a certain way. It can also mean look like when comparing people or things.
ex1_translation: He seems to be at home.
ex2_translation: This person looks like a teacher.
ex3_translation: I seem to know him.

notes: Used for something that fits, suits, or is appropriate for a time or situation.
ex1_translation: This piece of clothing fits well.
ex2_translation: This place is not very suitable.
ex3_translation: Now is a good time to go.

notes: A natural flowing body of water.
ex1_translation: This river is very long.
ex2_translation: There is a river in front of the school.
ex3_translation: There are many boats on the river.

notes: Common adjective meaning black in color. It can also describe things becoming dark.
ex1_translation: His hair is very black.
ex2_translation: It is already dark outside.
ex3_translation: This bag is black.

notes: The board a teacher writes on in a classroom.
ex1_translation: The teacher is writing on the blackboard.
ex2_translation: Please look at the sentence on the blackboard.
ex3_sentence: 黑板前面站着一位教师。
ex3_translation: A teacher is standing in front of the blackboard.

notes: Common noun and modifier for the color black.
ex1_translation: I like black.
ex2_translation: His phone is black.
ex3_translation: Black clothes look nice.

notes: Common adjective meaning red.
ex1_translation: This flower is red.
ex2_translation: Her face is a little red.
ex3_translation: The red clothes are on the bed.

notes: Common noun and modifier for the color red.
ex1_translation: Red is my favorite color.
ex2_translation: This bag is red in color.
ex3_translation: The red car is pretty.

notes: Usually marks what happened later in a sequence of events.
ex1_translation: At first I did not want to go, but later I went.
ex2_sentence: 他先在北京工作，后来回国了。
ex2_translation: He worked in Beijing first, and later returned to his country.
ex3_translation: Later, we all understood.

notes: Common adverb meaning suddenly or all of a sudden.
ex1_translation: It suddenly started to rain.
ex2_translation: He suddenly laughed.
ex3_translation: I suddenly wanted to go home.

notes: A large area of water surrounded by land.
ex1_translation: This lake is very big.
ex2_sentence: 我们下午去湖边坐一会儿。
ex2_translation: We will go sit by the lake for a while this afternoon.
ex3_translation: You can see the lake from this restaurant.

notes: The document used for international travel.
ex1_translation: You need to take a passport when going to another country.
ex2_translation: My passport is in my bag.
ex3_translation: My photo is in my passport.

notes: Often used for spending money or time, and for something costing a certain amount.
ex1_translation: I spent a lot of money today.
ex2_translation: This piece of clothing cost three hundred yuan.
ex3_sentence: 做这个菜要花很长时间。
ex3_translation: Making this dish takes a long time.

notes: An outdoor place for flowers or plants.
ex1_translation: There is a garden behind the school.
ex2_translation: The flowers in the garden have all opened.
ex3_translation: I like reading in the garden.

notes: Can be a verb meaning to draw or a noun meaning a picture or painting.
ex1_translation: My younger sister likes drawing little animals.
ex2_translation: I drew a person this afternoon.
ex3_translation: The teacher told me to draw a chicken.

notes: A person whose work is painting.
ex1_translation: He wants to become a painter.
ex2_translation: This painter paints very well.
ex3_sentence: 我在书上看过这位画家的名字。
ex3_translation: I have seen this painter's name in a book.

notes: A spoken-style noun for a picture or painting.
ex1_translation: This picture was drawn by a child.
ex2_translation: I really like that picture.
ex3_translation: The picture on the wall is very good.

notes: The bad side or harmful part of something.
ex1_translation: This matter also has disadvantages.
ex2_translation: There are many drawbacks to not exercising.
ex3_translation: Right now I still have not seen the downside.

notes: A person who does bad things.
ex1_translation: Children should not go away with bad people.
ex2_sentence: 电影里的坏人最后跑了。
ex2_translation: The bad person in the movie ran away in the end.
ex3_translation: He does not look like a bad person.

notes: Used to welcome a person or say that someone is gladly received.
ex1_translation: Welcome to our school.
ex2_translation: We all welcome the new classmate.
ex3_translation: The school welcomes parents to come take a look.

notes: Used for changing clothes, exchanging something, or switching to another one.
ex1_sentence: 天冷了，我想换一件衣服。
ex1_translation: It is cold, so I want to change into another piece of clothing.
ex2_sentence: 这件衣服太小了，我想换一件。
ex2_translation: This piece of clothing is too small, so I want to exchange it for another one.
ex3_translation: Please help me change seats.

notes: Common adjective meaning yellow.
ex1_translation: This flower is yellow.
ex2_translation: His hair is a little yellow.
ex3_translation: The yellow flower is on the table.

notes: Common noun and modifier for the color yellow.
ex1_translation: I like yellow.
ex2_translation: This bag is yellow in color.
ex3_translation: A yellow car is on the road.

primary_gloss: time; occasion; measure word for times
notes: A measure word used for how many times something happens.
ex1_translation: I have watched this movie twice.
ex2_translation: The teacher said this sentence three times.
ex3_translation: Please say it one more time. I did not hear it.

notes: Used when someone goes back to their home country.
ex1_translation: He is going back to his country next month.
ex2_sentence: 爸爸回国以后想看看朋友。
ex2_translation: After Dad returns to his country, he wants to see some friends.
ex3_translation: Many students return to their countries as soon as vacation starts.

notes: The HSK2 noun sense, not the HSK1 auxiliary verb.
ex1_translation: We have a meeting this afternoon.
ex2_sentence: 老师正在开会，你先等一下。
ex2_translation: The teacher is in a meeting, so wait a moment first.
ex3_sentence: 这个会很重要，经理也来。
ex3_translation: This meeting is important, and the manager is coming too.

notes: Common noun meaning an activity or event, often at school or in a group setting.
ex1_translation: There is an activity at school tomorrow.
ex2_sentence: 我们班都想去这个活动。
ex2_translation: Everyone in our class wants to go to this activity.
ex3_translation: This activity is very interesting.

notes: A shorter, more written-style word for or.
ex1_translation: Water or milk is fine.
ex2_translation: Going today or tomorrow is okay.
ex3_translation: You can read or listen to music.

notes: Used to link two or more options. It is often a little more neutral or written than 还是.
ex1_sentence: 你今天晚上或者明天早上来吧。
ex1_translation: Come either tonight or tomorrow morning.
ex2_sentence: 这件事你跟老师说，或者跟家长说。
ex2_translation: Tell the teacher about this, or tell the parents.
ex3_sentence: 我们可以去公园，或者去广场走走。
ex3_translation: We can go to the park, or go walk around the square.

notes: A favorable chance to do something.
ex1_translation: This is a very good opportunity.
ex2_translation: Opportunities like this are not common.
ex3_translation: I want to give the child a chance.

notes: Can mean the animal or chicken as food.
ex1_translation: I do not eat chicken.
ex2_translation: Mom bought a chicken.
ex3_translation: The chicken at this restaurant is very tasty.

notes: Common noun meaning level or grade. It often appears in study, school, and test contexts.
ex1_translation: I am studying Level 2 now.
ex2_translation: My younger sister is in first grade.
ex3_translation: This exam has three levels in total.

notes: Usually describes being rushed, worried, or urgent, not simply fast.
ex1_translation: I am a little rushed right now, so I am leaving first.
ex2_translation: This matter is urgent, so please take a quick look.
ex3_translation: Do not worry. We still have time.

notes: A plan or arrangement for what someone is going to do.
ex1_sentence: 我们下个月有一个旅行计划。
ex1_translation: We have a travel plan for next month.
ex2_translation: This plan is very good.
ex3_sentence: 他先看了计划，然后告诉了大家。
ex3_translation: He looked at the plan first and then told everyone.

notes: A formal word for computer.
ex1_translation: There are many computers at the school.
ex2_translation: I know how to use a computer.
ex3_translation: That computer is on the table.

notes: Used for adding something, putting something in, or increasing an amount.
ex1_translation: Please add a little water for me.
ex2_translation: Do not add characters after the name.
ex3_translation: It is cold, so add one more piece of clothing.

notes: Can mean to put fuel in a vehicle or to cheer someone on.
ex1_translation: You have an exam tomorrow, so keep it up.
ex2_translation: Let us fuel up the car first.
ex3_sentence: 再加油一点，你一定能做好。
ex3_translation: Keep it up a little more, and you will definitely do it well.

primary_gloss: suffix for a specialist or expert
notes: As a suffix, 家 forms words for people known for skill or expertise, such as 画家 and 作家.
ex1_translation: He wants to work as a painter.
ex2_translation: That author is very famous.
ex3_sentence: 画家和作家都要常看书。
ex3_translation: Painters and writers both need to read often.

notes: The family as a unit or household.
ex1_translation: She has a very good family.
ex2_translation: Family is very important for children.
ex3_sentence: 这个家庭常一起吃晚饭。
ex3_translation: This family often eats dinner together.

notes: Usually refers to the parents or guardians of a child.
ex1_sentence: 明天学校请家长来开会。
ex1_translation: The school is inviting parents to come to a meeting tomorrow.
ex2_translation: The teacher wants to talk with the parents.
ex3_sentence: 家长都很关心孩子的学习。
ex3_translation: Parents care a lot about the child's studies.

notes: Used for things that are not real or are false.
ex1_translation: This bag is fake.
ex2_translation: This is not real. It is false.
ex3_translation: The photo is fake.

notes: A period of days off such as a school vacation or holiday break.
ex1_sentence: 假期快到了，我想出去走走。
ex1_translation: Vacation is almost here, and I want to go out for a walk.
ex2_translation: We are not going home during this vacation.
ex3_translation: What plans do you have for the vacation?

notes: Used for checking things, homework, or a person's health.
ex1_translation: Check the door before you go out.
ex2_sentence: 医生让他明天来检查身体。
ex2_translation: The doctor asked him to come tomorrow for a health check.
ex3_sentence: 老师正在检查我们的作业。
ex3_translation: The teacher is checking our homework.

notes: Usually means to see or meet someone in person.
ex1_sentence: 我今天在学校见到他了。
ex1_translation: I saw him at school today.
ex2_translation: I am really happy to see you.
ex3_sentence: 如果见到老师，请告诉我。
ex3_translation: If you see the teacher, please tell me.

notes: Shows that someone has seen or met a person or thing before.
ex1_translation: I have seen this person before.
ex2_translation: Have you met that manager before?
ex3_translation: I think I have seen this book before.

primary_gloss: item; piece; measure word for clothes and matters
notes: Used as a measure word for clothes and for matters or events.
ex1_translation: There is a red piece of clothing in the shop.
ex2_translation: I already know about that matter.
ex3_translation: Mom bought two new pieces of clothing.

notes: Can describe good health or refer to health in general.
ex1_translation: He is very healthy.
ex2_translation: Health is more important than money.
ex3_translation: Our whole family is healthy.

notes: A common verb for speaking, explaining, or telling a story or point.
ex1_translation: The teacher explains very clearly.
ex2_sentence: 这本书在讲一个小孩子的故事。
ex2_translation: This book tells the story of a child.
ex3_translation: You speak first. I am listening.

notes: Usually used for talking or speaking aloud.
ex1_translation: The teacher is speaking.
ex2_translation: You speak too fast.
ex3_translation: They are talking in the room.

notes: Used for handing in homework, paying money, or giving something over.
ex1_translation: We need to hand in the homework tomorrow.
ex2_translation: Pay first, then go in.
ex3_sentence: 你想参加活动，要先交照片。
ex3_translation: If you want to join the activity, you need to hand in a photo first.

notes: Used when giving something to a specific person.
ex1_translation: Give this book to the teacher.
ex2_translation: Leave this matter to me.
ex3_translation: Give the photo to Dad.

notes: To become friends with someone.
ex1_translation: I want to make friends with the new classmate.
ex2_translation: He is very good at making friends.
ex3_sentence: 来这里以后，我和很多人交朋友了。
ex3_translation: After coming here, I made friends with many people.

notes: Can refer to traffic conditions or transportation in a place.
ex1_translation: Transportation here is very convenient.
ex2_sentence: 下班的时候，这里交通不太好。
ex2_translation: Traffic here is not very good when work ends.
ex3_translation: Traffic on this road is slow at night.

notes: Can refer to a corner, an angle, or an animal horn.
ex1_sentence: 照片的右上角有我的名字。
ex1_translation: My name is in the upper-right corner of the photo.
ex2_translation: The corner of the table hit my leg.
ex3_sentence: 故事里的坏人头上有角。
ex3_translation: The bad person in the story has horns on his head.
